settings.label: ts-setting-account-approval
settings.meaning: Whether registering files a request that a holder of `confirmaccount` approves, instead of creating the account at once ([07](07-actors-and-accounts.md) §2.6)

settings.label: ts-setting-account-creation_limit
settings.meaning: How many accounts one address key may create (and requests it may file) in a day before `createaccount` answers `acct_creation_throttle_hit` ([07](07-actors-and-accounts.md) §6.2); `noratelimit` is exempt. MediaWiki's `$wgAccountCreationThrottle`

settings.label: ts-setting-account-request_expiry
settings.meaning: How long an account request stays open before it is deleted

settings.label: ts-setting-account-request_statement
settings.meaning: Whether an account request asks for a statement of up to 1,000 characters

settings.label: ts-setting-blocks-max_per_page
settings.meaning: Bounds blocks per render

settings.label: ts-setting-blocks-max_rows
settings.meaning: Bounds every list a block renders

settings.label: ts-setting-blocks-refresh_debounce
settings.meaning: Coalesces the refresh of pages whose block dependencies changed

settings.label: ts-setting-category-collation
settings.meaning: Sort order of a category's members

settings.label: ts-setting-challenge-bits
settings.meaning: The base difficulty of a challenge, in leading zero bits of SHA-256: about 2^bits hashes

settings.label: ts-setting-challenge-max_bits
settings.meaning: The highest difficulty: one bit is added for each account created from the caller's address key in the last 24 hours, up to this

settings.label: ts-setting-challenge-triggers
settings.meaning: The acts a challenge guards ([07](07-actors-and-accounts.md) §2.6); the empty list turns challenges off

settings.label: ts-setting-constraints-scope
settings.meaning: Which entities the constraint consumer checks on composition: `local`, the local-graph statements and the entities in the tenant's overlay; `overlay`; or `all`, which is a batch job with progress and never a per-event step ([06](06-statements-and-properties.md))

settings.default_text: unset; a tenant with no licence set is warned, not refused
settings.label: ts-setting-content-licence
settings.meaning: The tenant's content licence, checked against a repository's when it is added to `pages.repos` and on a push

settings.label: ts-setting-discussion-share
settings.meaning: Whether a provider tenant's threads are shown read-only on reading tenants

settings.label: ts-setting-dumps-keep
settings.meaning: Previous dumps of each format kept per scope

settings.default_text: 0070 §2.3's list for Wikidata; empty for an entity source
settings.label: ts-setting-entities-closure
settings.meaning: Properties whose values are fetched transitively from every mirrored entity

settings.label: ts-setting-entities-closure_depth
settings.meaning: Depth of the closure

settings.label: ts-setting-entities-label_ttl
settings.meaning: Lifetime of the label cache

settings.default_text: `linked`; for an entity source, `linked` with an `api` and `off` without
settings.label: ts-setting-entities-mirror
settings.meaning: What of a provider's entities is mirrored; properties are always at least `on-demand`

settings.default_text: instance: the instance's content languages, `mul` and `en`; tenant: the instance's list
settings.label: ts-setting-entities-term_languages
settings.meaning: The instance record sets the languages in which a mirrored entity's terms populate the shared rows of `view.term` (§2.3); a tenant's record only narrows the languages its own pages and API display, and never adds a language to the shared rows
settings.scope_note: `site`; the instance record is the policy's

settings.label: ts-setting-export-from_namespaces
settings.meaning: Allows `addns` on `Special:Export`

settings.label: ts-setting-export-history
settings.meaning: Full history on export (`$wgExportAllowHistory`)

settings.label: ts-setting-export-max_bytes
settings.meaning: Cap on file contents in an export; over it, URLs are written

settings.label: ts-setting-export-max_entity_history
settings.meaning: Revisions per entity exported: the per-entity cap, lower than `export.max_history`, under which the export job folds per-revision entity export

settings.label: ts-setting-export-max_history
settings.meaning: Revisions per page exported (`$wgExportMaxHistory`)

settings.label: ts-setting-export-sync_revisions
settings.meaning: An export up to this size streams

settings.label: ts-setting-federation-accept_fep8b32
settings.meaning: Accept FEP-8b32 object integrity proofs inbound

settings.label: ts-setting-federation-accept_rfc9421
settings.meaning: Accept RFC 9421 HTTP message signatures inbound

settings.label: ts-setting-federation-clock_skew
settings.meaning: A request whose `Date` lies outside ± this is rejected

settings.label: ts-setting-federation-replay_window
settings.meaning: How long an accepted activity's `id` is kept in `ops.ap_inbox_seen`

settings.label: ts-setting-federation-talk_pages
settings.meaning: Which talk pages (and boards) are `as:Group` actors

settings.label: ts-setting-feeds-related_limit
settings.meaning: Members past which a related-changes relation is truncated

settings.label: ts-setting-files-commons_repo
settings.meaning: The repository that resolves `commonsMedia` values

settings.label: ts-setting-files-max_size
settings.meaning: Upload size limit (`file-too-large`)

settings.label: ts-setting-files-orphan_grace
settings.meaning: Grace before the orphan sweep deletes an unreferenced object

settings.label: ts-setting-files-repos
settings.meaning: The file repositories a tenant uses, in lookup order

settings.label: ts-setting-files-share
settings.meaning: Whether this tenant's files may serve other tenants as a `tenant` repository; under `providers.between_tenants = operator` only the operator can set it

settings.label: ts-setting-files-stash_ttl
settings.meaning: Expiry of a stash entry

settings.label: ts-setting-files-thumb_widths
settings.meaning: Requested widths are rounded up to the next entry

settings.label: ts-setting-follow-interval
settings.meaning: How often a follower without an event stream polls the wiki's recent changes
settings.scope_note: `site`, per follower: the instance record for a registry provider or a page repository, the tenant's for its entity sources

settings.label: ts-setting-follow-settle
settings.meaning: Within this of now, a poll reads by time from ten seconds before its position rather than by continuation
settings.scope_note: `site`, per follower: the instance record for a registry provider or a page repository, the tenant's for its entity sources

settings.label: ts-setting-follow-tail
settings.meaning: How far behind the head the tail pass re-reads, and how long seen rcids are remembered; PT0S turns the tail pass off
settings.scope_note: `site`, per follower: the instance record for a registry provider or a page repository, the tenant's for its entity sources

settings.label: ts-setting-fork-allow
settings.meaning: Whether pages may be forked

settings.label: ts-setting-fork-content_revisions
settings.meaning: Revisions, counted from the newest, seeded with their text; the rest of the seeded history is metadata only, and dependencies and archives are never seeded with text. `all` seeds every revision's text, under a ceiling of `all`

settings.label: ts-setting-fork-dependencies
settings.meaning: Whether a fork copies its templates or leaves them to the repository

settings.label: ts-setting-fork-history_source
settings.meaning: Where a fork's history is seeded from

settings.label: ts-setting-fork-max_dependencies
settings.meaning: Stops a fork job that would copy more pages

settings.label: ts-setting-fork-max_revisions
settings.meaning: The per-job budget: revisions, with or without text, a seeding job reads before it stops, including those a talk-page conversion reads for attribution; `all` reads every revision

settings.label: ts-setting-fork-refollow
settings.meaning: Whether a fork that no longer differs from upstream is offered or automatically re-followed

settings.label: ts-setting-fork-refollow_after
settings.meaning: Under `auto`, how long a fork must equal upstream before a job deletes it

settings.label: ts-setting-fork-talk
settings.meaning: Default choice for a fork's talk page

settings.label: ts-setting-ingest-hash_mismatch
settings.meaning: Whether a snak or reference hash that differs from upstream's is kept or aborts the job

settings.label: ts-setting-integrity-witness_partitions
settings.meaning: Which partitions' checkpoints are submitted to the witnesses

settings.label: ts-setting-integrity-witnesses
settings.meaning: C2SP tlog-witness endpoints that cosign the tenant's checkpoints ([01](01-log-and-records.md) §4.3)
settings.values: list of witnesses, each an endpoint URL and a signed-note verifier key

settings.default_text: `*`, every such issuer with a client credential
settings.label: ts-setting-login-issuers
settings.meaning: The external issuers whose logins the tenant admits, of those with a client credential; the instance default is what the auth host offers ([07](07-actors-and-accounts.md) §2.7, §2.8). A save leaving a tenant admitting nothing the auth host offers is refused
settings.values: issuer codes with `login = true` and an `oauth` table, or `*` for every one

settings.label: ts-setting-login-password
settings.meaning: Whether the tenant admits a login authenticated by its password; the instance default is whether the auth host offers passwords ([07](07-actors-and-accounts.md) §2.2)

settings.label: ts-setting-lua-client_site
settings.meaning: Which site Lua's Wikibase client is, and so which item a page is connected to
settings.values: a site ID with a site alias

settings.label: ts-setting-lua-ids
settings.meaning: What a bare one-letter ID means in Lua
settings.values: map from type letter to `local` or a provider code

settings.label: ts-setting-lua-unheld_ttl
settings.meaning: Expiry of a recorded miss on an unheld entity

settings.label: ts-setting-mcp-enabled
settings.meaning: Serve MCP at `{base}/mcp`

settings.label: ts-setting-mcp-facets
settings.meaning: The properties offered as filters and facets

settings.label: ts-setting-mcp-instructions
settings.meaning: The server's instructions at initialization

settings.label: ts-setting-mcp-max_results
settings.meaning: Results per call

settings.default_text: none: the tools range over the resolved view
settings.label: ts-setting-mcp-scope
settings.meaning: The scope the tools search within by default

settings.label: ts-setting-mcp-scopes
settings.meaning: Other scopes a client may select per session

settings.label: ts-setting-media-base_url
settings.meaning: The origin files are served from

settings.label: ts-setting-mediainfo-mirror
settings.meaning: `entities.mirror` for Wikidata's type `M`, under its own name for compatibility

settings.label: ts-setting-moderation-delete_group
settings.meaning: The default deletion group

settings.label: ts-setting-moderation-suppress_group
settings.meaning: The default suppression group

settings.label: ts-setting-notifications-fediverse_domains
settings.meaning: Domains fediverse notifications may go to

settings.label: ts-setting-notifications-retention
settings.meaning: When inbox rows are deleted

settings.label: ts-setting-nuke-confirm_threshold
settings.meaning: Items above which `Special:Nuke` asks for the target's name

settings.label: ts-setting-oauth-access_ttl
settings.meaning: Access token lifetime

settings.label: ts-setting-oauth-refresh_ttl
settings.meaning: Refresh token lifetime

settings.label: ts-setting-pages-repos
settings.meaning: Page repositories, in inheritance order; replaces `wikitext.template_repos`

settings.label: ts-setting-pages-share
settings.meaning: Whether this tenant's pages may serve other tenants as a `tenant` repository; replaces `wikitext.share`

settings.label: ts-setting-preferences-defaults
settings.meaning: Defaults for registered preference keys on this wiki, merged key by key over the instance's default for this setting

settings.label: ts-setting-projections-sync_budget
settings.meaning: Rows of composition fan-out the write path applies after commit before the rest is queued to the composition worker ([03](03-storage-caches-and-search.md))

settings.label: ts-setting-projections-sync_time
settings.meaning: Time the write path spends on that fan-out, whichever comes first

settings.label: ts-setting-proposals-adoption_grace
settings.meaning: After which a partly carried proposal is `partly adopted`

settings.label: ts-setting-proposals-direct_edit_lines
settings.meaning: Lines a clean merge may change and still push to the article itself

settings.label: ts-setting-proposals-max_items
settings.meaning: Bounds a proposal payload

settings.default_text: `off`; refused until the instance implements pushing
settings.label: ts-setting-proposals-push
settings.meaning: Whether proposals may be pushed upstream

settings.label: ts-setting-queries-max_params
settings.meaning: Parameters of a query page

settings.label: ts-setting-queries-max_scope_values
settings.meaning: Members a scope may bind as `VALUES`

settings.label: ts-setting-query-cache_ttl
settings.meaning: L2 lifetime of a `GET /sparql` response and of a query page's results

settings.label: ts-setting-query-enabled
settings.meaning: Turns the query service on

settings.label: ts-setting-query-max_lag
settings.meaning: Lag above which the service is unavailable

settings.label: ts-setting-query-max_results
settings.meaning: Bounds every query

settings.label: ts-setting-query-timeout
settings.meaning: Bounds every query, raw or compiled

settings.label: ts-setting-rc-max_age
settings.meaning: The recent-changes window

settings.label: ts-setting-reclaim-vouching
settings.meaning: Whether the wiki this tenant adopted vouches for its old users through that issuer, reclaiming their accounts at login ([07](07-actors-and-accounts.md) §2.5); the grace period is the time it is on
settings.values: `off`, or the code of an issuer that serves login

settings.label: ts-setting-repo-debounce
settings.meaning: Per-page debounce of repository events

settings.label: ts-setting-repo-mirror_grace
settings.meaning: A mirrored file unused this long is tombstoned

settings.label: ts-setting-reports-term_languages
settings.meaning: Languages the missing-label and missing-description reports cover

settings.label: ts-setting-retention-api_max_entities
settings.meaning: A bulk `retain` over this is refused for `api` unless forced

settings.label: ts-setting-retention-auto_properties
settings.meaning: Automatic `retain` of mirrored properties a tenant uses

settings.label: ts-setting-retention-default
settings.meaning: The retention the tenant's policy applies to a mirrored entity an upstream tombstone removes, where no `retain` row names it; `cascade` is never a default and is only ever set per entity

settings.label: ts-setting-schemas-max_bound
settings.meaning: Bound-schema × scope size above which binding a schema to a scope is refused at scope save, unless an operator raises the ceiling

settings.label: ts-setting-schemas-max_depth
settings.meaning: Shape references followed in validation

settings.label: ts-setting-schemas-max_subjects
settings.meaning: Bounds a schema's materialized report

settings.label: ts-setting-schemas-max_triples
settings.meaning: Triple budget per validation

settings.label: ts-setting-schemas-recheck
settings.meaning: Periodic re-validation job

settings.label: ts-setting-schemas-source
settings.meaning: Validate against the query store instead

settings.label: ts-setting-scopes-facet_limit
settings.meaning: Members below which the builder shows facets

settings.label: ts-setting-scopes-max_depth
settings.meaning: Nesting of scope operands

settings.label: ts-setting-scopes-max_ids
settings.meaning: `ids`, `include` and `exclude` together

settings.label: ts-setting-scopes-max_members
settings.meaning: Bound on a scope's materialized members

settings.label: ts-setting-scopes-refresh
settings.meaning: Refresh interval of `query` scopes

settings.default_text: `on` where a mirrored repository is listed
settings.label: ts-setting-search-inherited
settings.meaning: Whether `pages-{repo}` indexes are searched beside the tenant's

settings.default_text: off: a signature is never required by default
settings.label: ts-setting-signing-require_for_bot
settings.meaning: Require a client signature for the `bot` group

settings.label: ts-setting-site-icon
settings.meaning: The favicon and touch icon, served to anyone as a site asset, and `general.favicon` in `siteinfo`
settings.values: a site asset: PNG, ICO or SVG

settings.label: ts-setting-site-landing_text
settings.meaning: Text on a private tenant's landing page

settings.label: ts-setting-site-language
settings.meaning: The content language (`$wgLanguageCode`): `general.lang` in `siteinfo`, the default interface language, the language of `Project` page titles and the fallback for labels and reports

settings.default_text: none: the site name is shown as text
settings.label: ts-setting-site-logo
settings.meaning: The logo in the global header and on a private tenant's landing page, and `general.logo` in `siteinfo`; served to anyone as a site asset
settings.values: a site asset: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG

settings.label: ts-setting-site-name
settings.meaning: The wiki's name: `general.sitename` in `siteinfo`, the global header, the Project namespace's name, the tenant list's `name`, and the operator's display name when the tenant is primary
settings.values: a name, one line, valid as a namespace name

settings.label: ts-setting-sitelinks-schemes
settings.meaning: Allowed sitelink URL schemes

settings.default_text: the instance's default, else every installed skin
settings.label: ts-setting-skins-available
settings.meaning: The skins readers of this wiki may choose from, among those installed on the instance, up to the instance's ceiling

settings.label: ts-setting-skins-default
settings.meaning: The wiki's skin: the HTML presentation of every page, for readers who have not chosen another
settings.values: a skin the wiki makes available

settings.label: ts-setting-sprints-cache_ttl
settings.meaning: L1 lifetime of the `sp:` key

settings.label: ts-setting-sprints-claim_ttl
settings.meaning: A claim expires after this without a `release`

settings.label: ts-setting-sprints-max_claims
settings.meaning: Live claims an actor may hold on a sprint

settings.label: ts-setting-sprints-max_rules
settings.meaning: Rules per sprint

settings.label: ts-setting-sprints-max_tasks
settings.meaning: Tasks materialized per sprint

settings.label: ts-setting-subsidiaries-max_per_account
settings.meaning: Subsidiaries per operator

settings.label: ts-setting-subsidiaries-name_pattern
settings.meaning: Required pattern for subsidiary names

settings.label: ts-setting-subsidiaries-oauth_requires_approval
settings.meaning: Whether an OAuth-created subsidiary is pending

settings.label: ts-setting-subsidiaries-pending_ttl
settings.meaning: A subsidiary still unapproved after this is retired

settings.label: ts-setting-subsidiaries-request_page
settings.meaning: Where "Request bot approval" links

settings.label: ts-setting-tables-max_columns
settings.meaning: Columns of a table

settings.label: ts-setting-tables-max_rows
settings.meaning: Rows of a table

settings.label: ts-setting-talk-new_thread_default
settings.meaning: Which destination the new-thread form selects

settings.label: ts-setting-talk-upstream_audit_days
settings.meaning: How long a failed upstream send's text is kept

settings.label: ts-setting-talk-upstream_post
settings.meaning: Whether replies and new sections may be sent upstream at all

settings.label: ts-setting-templatestyles-max_bytes
settings.meaning: Largest TemplateStyles sheet

settings.label: ts-setting-theme-choice
settings.meaning: What readers may choose: `any` palette and type set the wiki offers, or only the accessibility choices (mode, contrast, text size, accessibility palettes and type sets), which are never withheld

settings.label: ts-setting-theme-palette
settings.meaning: The wiki's palette: the colours of every page, for readers who have not chosen another

settings.label: ts-setting-theme-typeset
settings.meaning: The wiki's type set: the typefaces of every page, for readers who have not chosen another
settings.values: a type set the tenant offers

settings.label: ts-setting-thread-markup
settings.meaning: The markup of new posts: Markdown, or wikitext as on MediaWiki talk pages. Posts already written keep theirs

settings.label: ts-setting-thread-max_attachments
settings.meaning: Home and listings of a thread together

settings.label: ts-setting-thread-max_pinned
settings.meaning: Pinned threads per page

settings.label: ts-setting-ui-count_threshold
settings.meaning: Counts above it (`ref_count`, revision counts) render as "10,000+" rather than exactly

settings.label: ts-setting-updates-enabled
settings.meaning: Whether the RDF delta consumer runs for this tenant, writing `view.rdf_delta` from composition events; off, no delta is computed and the update stream is unavailable ([02](02-graphs-rdf-and-query.md))

settings.label: ts-setting-updates-retention
settings.meaning: Window of `view.rdf_delta` rows

settings.label: ts-setting-upstream-retire_adopted
settings.meaning: Retire a local assertion when upstream adopts it

settings.label: ts-setting-wikitext-lua
settings.meaning: Lua modules; capped by `wikitext.ceiling`

settings.label: ts-setting-wikitext-renderer
settings.meaning: Which stage-2 renderer serves HTML. `parsoid` requires a Parsoid service on the instance

settings.label: ts-setting-wikitext-site_styles
settings.meaning: The tenant's `sanitized-css` site styles page

allowed.text: all, or a list of installed skins
